data.name: Enrica
data.gender_notes: Enrica is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Enrica is a Latin name derived from the word 'enricus', meaning 'rich' or 'powerful'. This name has been popular among Christians due to its association with the biblical figure Enricus, a Roman king believed to have been blessed with wealth. The name Enrica carries the meaning “Powerful, Rich” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Enrica usually hope their child will grow to embody powerful, rich and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name filled with rich blessings and divine power.
data.etymology: Enrica belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Powerful, Rich.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Enrica total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_hebrew.name: אנריקה
in_hebrew.meaning: אלוהים הוא השליט שלי, הבית שלי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אנריקה הוא שם שמקורו בשפה הגרמנית ומשמעותו 'אלוהים הוא השליט שלי' או 'הבית שלי'. השם הוא נגזר מהשם היידיש 'היינריך', שמורכב מהמילים 'היין' שפירושו 'בית' ו-'ריך' שפירושו 'שליט' או 'מלך'. השם אנריקה הוא בעל משמעות רוחנית עמוקה, הקשורה לרעיון של אלוהים כשליט ומושיע.

in_greek.name: Ενρίκα
in_greek.meaning: Ο Θεός είναι ο άρχοντας μου, το σπίτι μου
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ενρίκα προέρχεται από τη γερμανική γλώσσα και σημαίνει 'Ο Θεός είναι ο άρχοντας μου' ή 'το σπίτι μου'. Το όνομα είναι παράγωγο του ιδιστί 'Χάινριχ', που αποτελείται από τις λέξεις 'Χάιν' που σημαίνει 'σπίτι' και 'Ρίχ' που σημαίνει 'άρχοντας' ή 'βασιλιάς'. Το όνομα Ενρίκα έχει βαθιά πνευματική σημασία, που συνδέεται με την ιδέα του Θεού ως αρχόντα και σωτήρα.

in_latin.name: Enrica
in_latin.meaning: Deus est dominus meus, domus mea
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Enrica origine germanico derivatur et significat 'Deus est dominus meus' vel 'domus mea'. Nomen est derivativum idiomatis 'Heinrich', quod componitur ex vocibus 'Hein' quae significat 'domus' et 'Rich' quae significat 'dominus' vel 'rex'. Nomen Enrica profundam significationem spiritualem habet, quae connectitur cum idea Dei tamquam domini et salvatoris.

in_english.name: Enrica
in_english.meaning: God is my ruler, home ruler
in_english.long_meaning: The name Enrica originates from the Germanic language and means 'God is my ruler' or 'home ruler'. It is derived from the Yiddish name 'Heinrich', which is composed of the words 'Hein' meaning 'home' and 'Rich' meaning 'ruler' or 'king'. Enrica has a deep spiritual significance, connected to the idea of God as the ruler and savior. Historically, the name has been used in various Christian cultures, symbolizing faith and devotion. The personality traits associated with Enrica include leadership, strength, and a strong sense of faith.
